dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: The Lantern Rite is really quite different this year...

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: I'd heard that the Ministry of Civil Affairs was organizing a fireworks show, so I started pooling resources to make those fireworks through various channels.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Then halfway through, the news that Lady Ningguang was rebuilding the Jade Chamber broke, and the remuneration was so tempting that I changed tacks...

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: In the end, I failed to accomplish either project... I suppose there really is no room for indecisive dawdling in business.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: But although I didn't manage to seize this opportunity, I did still manage to prepare some material for Xiao Lanterns. Not for selling — just for sending them to my neighbors and friends.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: I hope that everyone will enjoy this year's Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Hi. Anything I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you selling?

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Best way to find out is to take a look around! I'm sure you'll find something you like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...?

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: I'm Changshun, a businesswoman and also a researcher in the field of Liyue Mercantilism.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Is there anything I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Liyue Mercantilism...?

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: That's right. Simply put, it's the philosophy of how to make as much Mora as possible, based on the accumulated wisdom of all the businesspeople in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: It's not enough in today's business environment to just throw yourself into the pursuit of profit. You have to educate yourself and consolidate the best practices from across the board to develop a successful business strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Yes, I heard about that down the grapevine...

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Liyue's economic boom could never have happened without the contributions of Rex Lapis. Even our coins, Mora, are named after him.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: There isn't a single businessperson in Liyue that doesn't worship him, and not a single transaction goes ahead that is not to his glory.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: So now this has happened... It's going to be cataclysmic for the business world. Things might already be changing as we speak.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Best of luck in all your business.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's business?

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: It's been quite good. Feiyun Slope is prime commercial real estate, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: If there was one snag, it would be that my store has never been graced with Rex Lapis' presence before...

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Uh, I mean, this new shop of mine has never had the honor of Rex Lapis' personal patronage.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Those stores that have met with both his presence and his approval have all become incredibly popular household names.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, this is not something that would happen just because I wish for it. Man proposes, and the Archon disposes...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Liyue's economic boom could never have happened without the contributions of Rex Lapis. Even our coins, Mora, are named after him.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: There isn't a single businessperson in Liyue that doesn't worship him, and not a single transaction goes ahead that is not to his glory.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: So now that he has departed... It's going to be cataclysmic for the business world. Things might already be changing as we speak.
